page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-96 is a memory-optimized server instance featuring 96 vCPUs and 744 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor with an x86_64 architecture, the system operates at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, achieving top-tier performance in Geekbench multi-core, image processing, and text processing tests. Cryptographic execution is highly efficient, with Passmark CPU encryption testing placing in the top tier. Memory subsystem performance is robust, showing strong uncached read bandwidth at 288.74 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 124.06 GB/sec. For language model workloads, the platform achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds of 297.98 tokens/sec using a medium 7B model.

The instance does not include local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware, meaning storage-heavy or graphics-accelerated tasks must rely on network-attached resources. However, its high memory density and strong multi-threaded processing make it highly cost-efficient for memory-bound enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
